properties.site-address: Golf Club House, Percy Wood Golf Club and Country Retreat, Swarland
properties.notes: Land currently occupied by a club house and car parking for adjacent golf course. Whilst availability is dependent on the future operational needs of the golf club, the site has been identified for redevelopment. Clearance of existing buildings would be required. An outline application for redevelopment of the site for 16 homes following demolition works is pending consideration (19/04108/OUT), The site is outwith the identified settlement boundary identified in the Local Plan. If permitted, the deliverability of the site will be reappraised but no residential development is forecast within the plan period at present.
